title: COS natural-fiber picks — verified on cos.com
summary: 17 COS.com items passed the natural-fiber gate (composition verified from live cos.com product records on 2026-10-19). The slim merino wool crew-neck sweater is excluded because COS has delisted it and its CDN gallery is empty. 7 screenshot items are excluded because COS.com confirmed synthetic or undisclosed-plant blends in their shell (tailored wool coat 23% polyamide, double-faced wool funnel-neck + overshirt 60/40 wool/lyocell, boiled wool shawl cardigan 17% polyester, zip-up cotton overshirt 3% elastane or lyocell blend, relaxed twill shirt 51% lyocell, oversized alpaca-blend crew 33% polyamide + 5% elastane). Gallery images captured from the official COS media CDN.
